title: Convert a plist file to a different format
summary: Change the format of a property list (plist) file, such as converting from binary to XML or JSON. You can overwrite the original file or save the result to a new file.

steps.explain: Convert the plist file to the desired format and save it to a new file using the -o flag. This preserves the original file.

placeholders.name: FORMAT
placeholders.description: Target format: xml1, binary1, json, swift, or objc

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the source plist file

placeholders.name: NEW_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the new file where the converted content will be saved

steps.explain: Alternatively, convert the file in-place, overwriting the original. Use this only if you don't need to keep the original format.

placeholders.name: FORMAT
placeholders.description: Target format: xml1, binary1, json, swift, or objc

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the plist file to convert and overwrite

alternatives.explain: Convert to XML format specifically, overwriting the original file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the plist file to convert and overwrite

alternatives.explain: Convert to binary format specifically, overwriting the original file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the plist file to convert and overwrite

warnings: Converting in-place overwrites the original file. Make a backup if the file is important.

rollback.explain: If you converted in-place and need to revert, you must restore from a backup. plutil does not provide an undo command for in-place conversions.
